This '''child''' was held prisoner in the [[shaper research facility]] on [[Dibrook]]. He was imprisoned along with his parents in a large bubble. When [[Tsalok]] fled the planet, he ordered the captured prisoners to be converted into [[thrall]]s to send a message to the rescuers. [[Arbeloa]] managed to rip open the enclosure and secure a [[Breath mask/Legends|breathing mask]] on the child to prevent him from inhaling the gas that caused the transformation.

He was later clad in an [[Environment suit/Legends|enviro-suit]] and fell asleep in Arbeloa's arms.
